def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    p4 = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    p6 = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    # Shape 6 specifies the reflected/rotated continuation of shape 4; find
    # the dihedral transform of shape 4 whose translated pixels align to it.
    min4r, min4c = min(r for r,c in p4), min(c for r,c in p4)
    a = {(r-min4r,c-min4c) for r,c in p4}
    H=max(r for r,c in a)+1; W=max(c for r,c in a)+1
    min6r,min6c=min(r for r,c in p6),min(c for r,c in p6)
    b={(r-min6r,c-min6c) for r,c in p6}
    bh=max(r for r,c in b)+1; bw=max(c for r,c in b)+1
    candidates=[]
    for flip in (False,True):
      for rot in range(4):
        pts={(r, W-1-c if flip else c) for r,c in a}
        hh=max(r for r,c in pts)+1; ww=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
        for _ in range(rot):
          pts={(c,hh-1-r) for r,c in pts}; hh,ww=ww,hh
        if (hh,ww)==(bh,bw):
          candidates.append(pts)
    # Output uses observed 6 silhouette recolored as 4, retaining 4-object.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in p6: out[r][c]=4
    return out
